title: Aligning to Social Norms and Values in Interactive Narratives
reasoning: The paper explicitly focuses on "Aligning to Social Norms and Values in Interactive Narratives," introduces a "moral reasoning model" called Delphi, and uses the "Jiminy Cricket benchmark" which includes "morality annotations" and "socially beneficial behaviors." It also trains on datasets like COMMONSENSE NORM BANK, a knowledge repository of everyday ethics. This clearly indicates a core component of evaluating and benchmarking morals/ethics.
